summary: The narrator and Professor Halliday are held captive and plan an escape. The narrator notes the meal tray arrives at 2:33 p.m. and proposes timing the next delivery to coordinate their escape before dark. Halliday wants to wait for Arthur, but the narrator refuses, and proposes setting fire to the papers of Halliday's half-finished proof to make the captors open the door and rush in. Halliday objects, calling it madness, and the narrator dismisses the risk of the concrete room burning.
one_line: Captive narrator and Professor Halliday plan a timed escape, proposing to fake a fire with Halliday's half-finished proof to draw captors through the door.
key_facts: The meal tray came through at thirty-three seconds past two p.m. according to the narrator's watch.
The narrator suggests the regular meal timing might be exact enough to use for executing the escape.
Halliday says her captors took her phone, so she cannot check the meal timing herself.
The narrator plans to time the next meal delivery and escape before dark.
Halliday wants to wait for Arthur, calling the plan foolhardy and reckless.
The narrator says, "Reckless is where I live."
The narrator reasons that the captors would rush in to save them if they were in danger from a fire.
The narrator proposes burning the papers of the half-finished proof on the table as fuel for a fire.
The half-finished proof is described by Halliday as her life's work.
Halliday says recreating the proof has taken a great deal of effort, and the narrator replies that the second time will be easier.
The narrator argues the captors should not be left with a copy of the proof, and that burning it means they will not have to carry it.
Halliday asks how they would ignite anything and what would stop the fire from killing them before rescue arrives.
The narrator says the room is concrete and smoke inhalation will be the only problem.
The narrator notes the regular meals give scheduled chances of contact with captors, which could be used for a timed action.

entities.name: Halliday
entities.role: Professor, captive who wants to wait for Arthur and objects to burning the proof

entities.name: Arthur
entities.role: Person Halliday wants to wait for before escaping
